annotation_rule: Independent manual reading against each field's selected RecruiterProposition, synthetic JD requirement and InterviewQuestionIntent. Model-selected handles and blind audit are diagnostics, not entailment proof. An open question can still presuppose personal participation, experience or decision. Uncertain is not counted as confirmed unsupported.
